    Bot Fleet Monitoring

    Click "Refresh" to load stats — this page never auto-refreshes on its own, so it never adds background load.

    Only removes sessions that are NOT currently connected — a live bot is never touched. Refresh first.
    All databases
    Every database in one place. New bots are saved in the first sessions database that is under the limit, and move on to the next one by themselves when it fills up. To add one, put its link on the site as the next SESSIONS_MONGODB_URI_N and redeploy — it appears here by itself.
    Spread servers across databases
    Every server gets one home database and keeps all its bots there, so a database is only connected to by its own servers (far fewer connections). New servers pick the database with the fewest servers by themselves — also after you clear the fleet and create new ones. Press Check to see the spread, then move the bots that are in the wrong place.
    bots at a time
    Move bots to another database
    Frees space in a crowded sessions database by moving running bots' backups to another one. Only bots on updated servers move (an older server would just keep saving in the old place). The bot switches within ~5 minutes; the old copy is deleted only after the bot has really saved in the new database, so nobody is left without a backup.
    bots
    Reset databases
    Tick the databases to reset. For each one it deletes the servers that belong to it (from Heroku too, if they are still there), empties every bot backup and saved file in it, and removes the site's records of those bots — so the database is free for new servers. The Main database only loses its bots' data, never accounts, payments or chat. It runs in the background and you can cancel it at any time.
    Dead servers
    When a Heroku account expires, its servers vanish but their bots' backups stay in the databases. This finds servers whose Heroku app is gone (or whose account can no longer be used and which no longer answer) and clears them out of every database, so the space can be used again.
    Bot backups
    Finds bots that are running on the servers but are NOT saved in any database (they would be lost on a restart or an Update), and asks their servers to save them now. Never deletes anything. It also runs by itself a few minutes after the site starts and every 6 hours.
    Main database
    Your site's data (users, sessions list, chat…) and the bots that were paired before the sessions database was added — those stay here and keep working.
    Show details & tools
    Collections (clear)
    Clearing wipes every document in it right now, with no undo. You must type its exact name to confirm.
    Databases on this cluster (delete unused)
    Bot session backups (analyze)
    What the saved sessions in the main database take, which belong to servers that no longer exist, and what a backup is made of. Read-only until you press delete.

    Press Analyze — never auto-loads.

    Servers' memory (RAM of the site and each bot server)
    The working memory each server is using right now — separate from the database's own RAM above.
    Migrate to a new cluster (advanced)
    Copies every document from the main database into a brand-new cluster — nothing on this one is touched or deleted. This is step 1 of 2: after it finishes and you've checked the new cluster looks right, the site's own connection string still has to be switched over separately before anything actually changes for real users. Bot servers already deployed are never affected.
    Chat database
    Only the community chat (messages and pictures). Set it with CHAT_MONGODB_URI. Without it the chat lives in the main database and keeps 24 hours; with it, 2 days.
    Sessions database
    Used only for the saved sessions of bots paired from now on. Older bots stay where they are. A new bot goes to the first sessions database holding fewer than 500 bots, so when one is at 500 the next one takes over by itself (bots already there are never removed).

    Site-Wide Maintenance
    Takes the ENTIRE site down to a "come back soon" page for every visitor — nobody can sign up, log in, or pair a bot while this is on. You still get in on this device to flip it back off.
    Payments
    Turn this off to stop NEW payments (coin top-ups and Premium). Anyone who already paid is still confirmed and given what they paid for, and the site stays online.
    Free Bot Spaces
    How many bot slots a brand-new free account starts with. Optionally bump every existing free (non-admin, non-Pro) account up to the new number too.
    Free Daily Limits
    How many Channel Reacts and Channel Poll Votes a free account can use each day (it starts again at midnight UTC). Each one still costs 1 coin. Type 0 to make it Premium only. Premium accounts are not affected.
    Auto Follow
    Put a channel id, choose how many bots should follow it (drag the slider, or tap Max for all) and send. Just once asks the bots that are connected now. Keep going also makes every bot that connects during that time follow it. The channels written in the bot's code keep working as before. Sending asks for your date of birth and PIN.

    Advertisements
    Each ad has its own switch and all are off until you turn them on. Premium accounts never see ads. The slim banner shows under the header and above the footer on every page (not on Community or Admin) and scrolls with the page — it is not sticky.
    Mobile app

    Seasonal Themes
    Turn on a celebration and the whole site dresses up for it on every page (Channel Reacts too): falling snow / confetti / hearts, a hat or badge on the logo, a decorated header edge and matching colours. One at a time — all are off until you switch one on, and switching it off puts the site back to normal. People who picked their own accent colour keep it. Preview shows it on this device only.

    Heroku API key not set
    Add HEROKU_API_KEY to .env (Account Settings → API Key on heroku.com) and restart the site to use this feature.
    Add Servers
    Creates real Heroku apps automatically — each one runs its own copy of the bot with a session cap you set, and gets wired into pairing routing the moment it's live. Takes a minute or two per server (real Heroku builds). Nothing to configure on Heroku's side first — same as your original app.
    The new servers are created in this account. Add more accounts by putting HEROKU_API_KEY_2, HEROKU_API_KEY_3… in .env and redeploying the site.
    Fleet
    Bots per server — 0 selected
    Raise to at least: a server that is already higher keeps its higher number.
    Set exactly: every selected server gets this number, higher or lower. Lowering never removes a bot: a server with more bots than the new number keeps them all and shows e.g. 15 / 10, and nobody new can join it until it drops below 10.
    Each server that changes restarts once (bots reconnect by themselves).
    Servers
    Loading…
    Move bots
    Takes bots off one server and puts them on servers that still have room, on any Heroku account. No server is ever filled past its limit. Both servers must already run the newest code.
    Move premium bots to premium servers
    Finds every premium bot that is on an ordinary server and moves it to the servers marked premium server, as far as they have room. Nobody has to pair again. A premium bot that does not fit stays where it is and is listed here, so you can move it after you add another premium server. Mark a server as premium from the Fleet table (select it, then Premium server).
    Automatic premium care
    The first and last switches are off until you turn them on; "Keep servers under their limit" is on until you turn it off. Every move keeps the bot's saved login, so nobody pairs again, and each bot reconnects within seconds.
    Keep premium bots on premium servers
    Premium bots move to premium servers by themselves (a few at a time, every 15 minutes). When a number's premium has ended for a day, its bot moves back to an ordinary server so it stops using premium room, and moves up again if it is renewed. With no room the bot waits where it is.
    Keep servers under their limit
    A server that holds more bots than its limit runs out of memory and keeps restarting. A few extra bots do no harm, so nothing moves until a server holds 35 bots or more. Then its extra bots are moved quietly to servers with room (30 at a time, never past anyone's limit; a premium server sheds onto other premium servers). Each bot gets one try: if a move fails it stops for that server, even after a restart, and the red alert at the top of Admin says so. With no room anywhere the alert says to add a server. Turning this off and on lets it try again.
    Move premium servers to the next Heroku account
    A few days before a Heroku account runs out, its premium servers are handed to the account that lasts longest. Heroku does not tell us when an account runs out, so set the date for each account below.
    Move days before it runs out
    Heroku accounts
    Move servers between Heroku accounts
    Pick the account the servers are on now, tick the ones to move (free or premium), then pick the account that should own them. Only the Heroku owner changes: the bots keep running, with no restart. Do it before the old account's Heroku plan ends. Moving does not free database space — the bots' saved data stays in the same database.
    Move Fleet to a Different Heroku Account
    For when this Heroku account is expiring or getting shut down. This moves OWNERSHIP of the apps you select to a different account — the bots on them keep running the whole time, no restart, no redeploy. Must be done BEFORE the current account's key stops working — a suspended or deleted account can't offer a transfer, so this only works done ahead of time, not as a recovery after the fact. After moving, update HEROKU_API_KEY to the new account's key so future Add/Update/Delete here uses it.
    Check the box(es) in the Fleet table above for the app(s) to move, then come back down here.

    Privacy Policy

    Your privacy matters to us. Here's a short, plain-language summary of how KING MD handles your data.

    What we collect

    When you create an account, we store your email address, name and a securely hashed password. We never store your password in plain text. We also store the WhatsApp number you pair a bot with, and basic usage data (bot spaces, coins, referrals) needed to run the service.

    How it's used

    Your data is used only to run your account: pairing bots, tracking coins and referrals, showing your profile to other users (with the privacy controls you set), and sending you account notifications. We don't sell your data to anyone.

    Who can see what

    Your username, photo, bio, and public stats are visible to other signed-in users. Your email is never shown to anyone but you. You control whether your Following list and last-active status are visible to others from your Profile page.

    Payments

    Coin purchases are processed by Korapay — we never see or store your card details.

    Advertising

    Free accounts see third-party advertisements, marked “Advertisement”. They are served by an outside advertising network, not by us, and are not related to or endorsed by KING MD. That network may use cookies or similar technology to choose which ads to show; we never give it your account details. Premium accounts see no ads. When you choose Watch an ad to earn coins, you leave KING MD for the advertiser's own website: their privacy policy applies there, not ours, and we advise you not to enter any personal information on that page. See Advertisements in the Terms & Conditions.

    Your control

    You can edit your name, username, and privacy settings any time from your Profile. Want your account or data removed entirely? Contact an admin from the Community page and we'll take care of it.

    Terms & Conditions

    By using KING MD V4, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully.

    Disclaimer

    KING MD V4 is made for learning and research, and for people who want to automate their own WhatsApp number. Please use it responsibly and in line with WhatsApp's Terms of Service. How the bot is used is each user's own responsibility, and we can't be held responsible for misuse. Inspired by the original work of Baileys and improved by the community.

    QUICK NOTE

    Once you purchase a premium number, you cannot change it later. If you wish to use a different premium number, you will have to pay for a new one.

    If your bot disconnects and you reconnect using the same number, your premium subscription will remain active until your current subscription expires.

    1. Acceptance of terms

    By creating an account or using KING MD V4, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

    2. Eligibility

    You create an account with your email address and password. Passwords are securely hashed. You must be able to form a binding agreement in your country, and you're responsible for anything done through your account.

    3. The bot service

    KING MD lets you pair your own WhatsApp number to a bot you control. Free accounts get a limited number of bot spaces; coins can unlock more, or a Premium number unlocks extra features. You must only pair numbers you own or have permission to automate, and must not use the bot to spam, harass, or break WhatsApp's own terms.

    4. Coins

    Coins are a virtual currency used only inside KING MD — to unlock bot space, redeem features, send gifts to other users, or pay for Channel Reacts and Channel Poll Voting. They have no real-world monetary value, cannot be exchanged for cash, and we may adjust the coin economy (prices, rewards) at any time.

    5. Purchases

    Coin top-ups and ad payments are processed through Korapay — we never see or store your card details. Purchases are final once coins are credited, unless required otherwise by law.

    6. Channel Reacts & Channel Poll Voting

    Channel Reacts sends reactions to a WhatsApp channel post, and Channel Poll Voting sends votes to a channel poll, using our fleet of bots. Free accounts get a small daily number of reactions and poll votes (shown on each page), and each one costs 1 coin. Premium accounts get 10 free reactions and 5 free poll votes per day with a 1-minute cooldown; after those, each use costs 1 coin. Use them only on channels and polls you own or are authorized to promote — not to harass or spam a channel that hasn't asked for it.

    7. Account suspension

    We may suspend, ban, or hold a number or account that abuses the service, violates these terms, or engages in fraud. You can request deletion of your own account any time from your Profile — it's scheduled 7 days out so you can cancel if you change your mind.

    8. Service availability

    KING MD is provided free, with Premium add-ons. We aim for steady uptime but don't guarantee uninterrupted service — bot servers can restart, and features may change, be added, or be removed at any time.

    9. Limitation of liability

    The platform is provided “as is.” To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the service, or from how WhatsApp itself treats a number you've linked.

    10. Advertisements

    KING MD shows third-party advertisements to free accounts; Premium accounts see none. Banners are marked “Advertisement”. These ads are not part of our site and not a partnership with us — we do not own, create or endorse them, or the websites, products and services they lead to. They are served by an outside advertising network, which may show different ads to different visitors and may use cookies to do so. Some ads open the advertiser's website in a new tab or show small pop-up style notices; what you do there is between you and them. The money from these ads helps pay for the servers that keep KING MD free. If an ad ever looks harmful or misleading, tell us through the Community page or the Contact Us link in the footer and we will look into it.

    Watching ads for coins (external links)

    When you tap Watch an ad on the Tasks page, a new tab opens with an advertiser's website. That page is outside KING MD: we do not own it or control it, we cannot see what happens there, and we are not responsible for its content, offers, downloads or how it handles your data. You only need to keep it open for a few seconds, then come back and tap the claim button. We advise you not to enter any personal information on that page (passwords, card or bank details, phone numbers or verification codes) and not to download or install anything from it. If anything looks suspicious, just close the tab.

    11. Changes to these terms

    We may update these terms at any time. Continued use after a change means you accept the update.

    12. Not affiliated with WhatsApp Inc.

    KING MD is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp Inc. or Meta Platforms, Inc. "WhatsApp" is a trademark of its respective owner.

    13. Contact

    Questions about these terms can be sent through the Community page, or via WhatsApp from the Contact Us link in the footer.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Everything you need to know about KING MD V4.

    What is KING MD V4?
    A free bot hosting platform — deploy and manage your own bot from one dashboard, no hosting or coding needed. We also run Channel Reacts, Channel Poll Voting and a small community around it.
    Is it free to use?
    Yes. Every account starts with free bot spaces. Coins and Premium unlock extra space and features, but the core bot is free.
    What are coins, and how do I get them?
    Coins are KING MD's in-site currency — they unlock extra bot spaces, pay for Channel Reacts and Channel Poll Voting, and redeem Premium codes. You get 3 when you join, 1 for following our socials and 1 for referring 2 friends. Spin the Daily Spin once a day for a chance to win more. You can also buy coins on the site.
    How does Channel Reacts work?
    Paste a WhatsApp channel post link and our fleet of bots reacts to it. Free accounts have a small daily limit, and each react costs 1 coin; Premium gets 10 free reactions per day with a 1-minute cooldown.
    How does Channel Poll Voting work?
    Paste a WhatsApp channel post that has a poll, choose an option and send the poll vote. Free accounts have a small daily limit, and each vote costs 1 coin; Premium gets 5 free poll votes per day with a 1-minute cooldown. If the post is not a poll, the page points you to Channel Reacts instead.
    What does Premium give me?
    A Premium number gets its own bot identity (name, picture, channel), 10 free Channel Reacts and 5 free Poll Votes every day, and other perks shown on the Premium page — unlocked by paying on the site (Upgrade → Pay on the site) or with a redeem code.
    Why are there ads, and are they yours?
    The ads you see are marked Advertisement. They come from an outside advertising network and are not related to KING MD or its owner; we do not endorse them. The small income they bring helps keep the bots free. Premium accounts see no ads.
    Is my data safe?
    We only store what's needed to run your account — see the full Privacy Policy. Coin payments go through Korapay directly; we never see your card details.
    My bot stopped responding — what do I do?
    Reopen the pairing page and generate a fresh code for the same number — WhatsApp sometimes unlinks a device after inactivity. If it keeps happening, reach out from the Community page.
    How do I delete my account?
    From your Profile, request account deletion. It's scheduled 7 days out, and you can cancel any time before then.
    How do I contact support?
    Use the Community chat, or the Contact Us link in the footer to reach us on Telegram (@real_KING MD).

    API keys
    Create a key

    A key lets your own app or script use your account. It uses your coins and daily free uses, just like the website. You can have up to 3 (Premium accounts: 5).

    Never share a key. If one leaks, revoke it and make a new one.
    My API keys
    Tap Test to load a key into the playground. A key is shown only when it is created; a key made in this browser is remembered here so Test can fill it in for you.
    API
    Endpoints & Playground
    Endpoints
    Base address: . GET or POST. Send the key as apikey=YOUR_KEY or in the x-api-key header.
    GET /api/v1/account FREE
    Your coin balance, whether you are Premium, and what is left of today's free uses. Free: uses no coins.
    GET /api/v1/account?apikey=YOUR_KEY
    GET /api/v1/channel-react COINS
    Send reactions to a WhatsApp channel post. Costs coins: 1 coin per request (Premium: the 10 free daily requests first). No waiting time on the API, but you are limited to 5 requests per 10 seconds.
    link (required): the channel post link · amount (optional): how many reactions, leave out for the most possible · emoji (optional): up to 5 separated by commas, e.g. ❤️,👍 · random=1: random emojis.
    GET /api/v1/channel-react?apikey=YOUR_KEY&link=https://whatsapp.com/channel/XXXX/123&amount=50&emoji=❤️,👍
    GET /api/v1/poll-info FREE
    Reads a channel poll: its question and the options. The first option is number 0. Free: needs your key but uses no coins.
    GET /api/v1/poll-info?apikey=YOUR_KEY&link=https://whatsapp.com/channel/XXXX/123
    GET /api/v1/poll-vote COINS
    Send votes to a channel poll. Costs coins: 1 coin per request (Premium: the 5 free daily requests first). No waiting time on the API.
    link (required) · option (required): the option number from poll-info · amount (optional).
    GET /api/v1/poll-vote?apikey=YOUR_KEY&link=https://whatsapp.com/channel/XXXX/123&option=0&amount=50
    What the answer looks like
    {
  "creator": "KING MD Tech",
  "success": true,
  "request": { "channel": "XXXX", "postId": "123", "amount": 50, "emojis": ["❤️"] },
  "result": { "reactionsSent": 50, "botsUsed": 50, "status": "sent", "paidWith": "1 coin" },
  "account": { "username": "you", "coins": 119, "premium": false }
}
    Each endpoint answers with only what belongs to it. On a problem you get "success": false and an "error" that says what to do. Going over the rate limit gives HTTP 429 (rate limiting).
    PlaygroundReal requests: they use your coins and daily free uses.
    The copied link contains your key, so keep it private.
    
        
    

  
    For more, visit our API documentation page.

    Free accounts can be signed in on 1 device at a time. Premium accounts can use up to 3.
